ValidationRule.description: A branding return case cannot reach Completed until Mahesh has chosen the vendor and recorded what became of the asset. Scoped to the transition with ISCHANGED so a completed case is not trapped by later edits.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Case_Type__r.Name = 'Branding & Marketing Asset transfer Request', ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), OR( ISBLANK(Vendor__c), ISPICKVAL(Branding_Return_Status__c, '') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select the Vendor and Branding Return Status on this approval page, then approve.
